Jinjie Liang
received the B.S. degree in
electronic information science and technology
from Huizhou University, Huizhou, China, in
2019. He is currently pursuing the M.S. degree in electronics and communication engineering from Guangdong University of Technology,
Guangzhou, China. His current research interest
includes indoor localization and federated learning.

Zhenyu Liu
received the B.S. and M.S. degresss in electronic circuit and system form Xidian University, Xi’an, China, in 1999 and 2002,
and the Ph.D. degrees in signal and information
processing from South China University of Technology, Guangzhou, China, in 2008. He was a
electronics engineer for radio communication in
Guangzhou Haige Communications Group from
2002 to 2005 and was a postdoctor for security
of 3G/4G communication in South China University of Technology from 2008 to 2011. From
2014 to 2015, he was a Visiting Scholar with the School of Electrical and
Information Engineering, University of Sydney, Sydney, NSW, Australia.
He is currently Associate Professor and the dean in Department of Communication Engineering, School of Information Engineering and Technology,
Guangdong University of Technology, Guangzhou, China. His research
interests include radar signal processing, wireless communication, internet
of things and network security.

Zhiheng Zhou
received the B.S. and M.S.
degrees in applied mathematics and the Ph.D.
degree in electronic and information engineering from South China University of Technology,
Guangzhou, China, in 2000, 2002, and 2005,
respectively. He is currently a Professor with
South China University of Technology. His research interests include image processing and
image and video transmission.

Yan Xu
received the B.S. degree in electronic
and information engineering from Guangxi University of Science and Technology, Liuzhou,
China, in 2020. He is currently pursuing the
M.S. degree in electronics and communication engineering from Guangdong University of
Technology, Guangzhou, China. His current research interest includes image processing and
deep learning.
